title: Banff Gondola Tickets
metaTitle: Banff Gondola Tickets | Sulphur Mountain Summit Views – Vista Chase
metaDescription: Ride the Banff Gondola to the top of Sulphur Mountain for 360° views over six mountain ranges. Add tickets to your Vista Chase tour or book them on their own.

overview.heading: Banff from above
paragraphs: The Banff Gondola carries you up Sulphur Mountain to a summit with views across the Bow Valley, Banff town and six mountain ranges. At the top, the boardwalk leads to Sanson's Peak and its historic weather station, and the summit building has viewing decks, exhibits and places to eat.

includes: Access to the summit boardwalk and viewing decks
Help choosing a time slot that fits your tour day
excludes: Transport to the gondola base, unless added to a Vista Chase tour

stops.text: Viewing decks over the Bow Valley, Mount Rundle and the town of Banff.

title: Lake Minnewanka Cruise Tickets
metaTitle: Lake Minnewanka Cruise Tickets | Banff's Largest Lake – Vista Chase
metaDescription: Cruise Lake Minnewanka, the largest lake in Banff National Park, with live commentary on its history and wildlife. Add tickets to your Vista Chase tour.

overview.heading: Out on the Lake of the Spirits
paragraphs: Lake Minnewanka, “Lake of the Spirits” in Stoney Nakoda, stretches deep between the Palliser and Fairholme ranges. The cruise heads out toward Devil's Gap with commentary on the lake's history, its drowned townsite and the wildlife along the shore.

excludes: Transport to the lake, unless added to a Vista Chase tour

stops.name: Devil's Gap
stops.text: The narrows at the far end of the lake, framed by steep peaks.

stops.name: Lake Minnewanka marina
stops.text: Boarding point, a short drive from Banff.

title: Columbia Icefield Skywalk Tickets
metaTitle: Columbia Icefield Skywalk Tickets | Glass Walkway on the Icefields Parkway – Vista Chase
metaDescription: Walk out on the glass-floored Columbia Icefield Skywalk above the Sunwapta Valley on the Icefields Parkway. Add tickets to your Icefields Parkway tour.

overview.heading: A glass floor above the valley
paragraphs: The Skywalk is a cliff-edge walkway with a glass floor, high above the Sunwapta Valley near the Columbia Icefield. It pairs naturally with the Athabasca Glacier and our Icefields Parkway tours, and can be combined with the Ice Explorer ride onto the glacier.

title: Banff Upper Hot Springs Tickets
metaTitle: Banff Upper Hot Springs Tickets | Mountain-View Hot Pool – Vista Chase
metaDescription: Soak in the Banff Upper Hot Springs, a natural hot pool on Sulphur Mountain with views of Mount Rundle. Add entry to your Vista Chase day.

overview.heading: Warm water, mountain views
paragraphs: The Upper Hot Springs pool sits on the slope of Sulphur Mountain above Banff, fed by natural hot spring water and facing Mount Rundle. It is an easy, relaxing way to end a day of sightseeing, in summer or with snow all around in winter.

excludes: Transport, unless added to a Vista Chase tour
